title: Improve Edit Task form layout and spacing
description:
The Edit Task modal form has several layout/formatting issues that make it look cramped and misaligned: 1. **Origin row wastes space** — Uses a 3-column grid but only the first column has content (two empty div placeholders). Should be a single full-width field or a narrower row without empty columns. 2. **Poor vertical separation between Origin hint and Description label** — The 'Set automatically — cannot be changed' hint text from the Origin field runs directly into the Description label below with insufficient spacing, making them visually merge together. 3. **Priority/Type/State row is cramped** — When editing, the State dropdown is shown in the same 3-column row as Priority and Type. The State label appears slightly disconnected. Consider giving State its own visual weight or adjusting the grid so all three fields have equal proportions and consistent label alignment. 4. **Overall form density** — The gap between form sections (especially around the Origin read-only row) should be increased slightly to create clearer visual groupings. Fixes needed in CSS (style.css): - Adjust `.form-row` or add a variant for the Origin row (e.g. single-column or auto-fit) - Increase margin/gap between the Origin group and Description group - Ensure consistent vertical rhythm throughout the form Fixes needed in HTML (index.html): - Remove the two empty `
` placeholders in the Origin row - Potentially restructure the Origin row to not use the 3-column `.form-row` class
